dataformat.name: tarFile
dataformat.title: Tar File
dataformat.description: Archive files into tarballs or extract files from tarballs
dataformat.label: dataformat,transformation,file

marshalIn.description: The content of the one entry: text, bytes, a stream or a file. The entry size is taken from the content, not from the CamelFileLength header

marshalOut.description: The tar file, not compressed, in the stream cache, or a byte array when stream caching is off. The CamelFileName header is the entry name with .tar

unmarshalIn.description: A tar file with one entry, or with several when usingIterator. A .tar.gz is unmarshalled with gzipDeflater first

unmarshalOut.description: The content of the one file in the stream cache, or a byte array when stream caching is off; folder entries are skipped, and a tar with more files fails. With usingIterator, an Iterator for the split EIP: of messages with the content of one file each, in a stream cache

usingIterator.description: Whether to use an iterator to split tar entries when the tar file has more than one entry, for use with the splitter EIP in streaming mode.

allowEmptyDirectory.description: Whether to allow getting the iterator even if the directory is empty, when the tar file has more than one entry.

preservePathElements.description: Whether to preserve path elements when the file name contains path elements in the tar file.

maxDecompressedSize.label: advanced
maxDecompressedSize.description: The maximum decompressed size of a tar file (in bytes). An IOException is thrown if the decompressed size exceeds this amount. Set to -1 to disable.
